fr.recommendations:
• Install a reflective address marker at the driveway entrance so responders can identify the property quickly from the road.
• Trim vegetation along both sides of the access drive so emergency vehicles can pass without obstruction.
• Cut back tree branches overhanging the access drive to maintain vertical clearance for fire and rescue vehicles.
• Clear a turnaround area at or near the main residence so vehicles are not required to back out along the full length of the drive.
• Thin dense vegetation between the road and the residence to give arriving responders a clear view of the main structure.
• Trim vegetation growing against or directly adjacent to the main residence and detached structure so responders can move around both buildings without obstruction.
• Keep a clear path between the main residence and the detached structure so responders can move between the two buildings during an emergency.
• Mark the detached structure with a visible address or unit identifier so responders can distinguish it from the main residence when navigating the property.
• Maintain a minimum ten-foot clear zone around the detached structure by removing shrubs and low branches that press against its walls or roofline.
• Post a property map or structure diagram at the driveway entrance showing the location of both structures, the access drive, and any additional entry points.

wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim tree branches that hang over or touch the roof and walls of the house.
• Thin the tree clusters closest to the structure to create open space between the trees and the building.
• Remove shrubs growing directly against or within a few feet of the house.
• Cut back ground-level vegetation growing beneath the tree clusters near the structure.
• Clear dead grass, leaves, and other loose plant material from around the base of the house.
• Thin shrubs and low-growing plants along both sides of the driveway to keep the travel lane open.
• Trim tree branches that hang over the driveway to a height that allows emergency vehicles to pass through.
• Keep the driveway surface clear of fallen branches, leaf litter, and overgrown grass along its full length.
• Separate the scattered shrubs near the house from the surrounding ground vegetation by removing the plants in between.
• Thin the mixed vegetation adjacent to the structure to create visible open ground between plant groupings and the building.
• Keep the area immediately around the house as open as possible by removing low-growing plants that connect the yard vegetation to the structure.
